title: Start of the HIV/AIDS pandemic (first reported cases, 1981)
summary: On 5 June 1981 the US Centers for Disease Control reported Pneumocystis pneumonia in five young men in Los Angeles, two of whom died; these are recognised as the first reported cases of what became known as AIDS. By 1985 the UN stated that every region of the world had reported at least one HIV case. WHO attributes about 44.2 million deaths (range 33.8–61.1 million) to HIV-related causes since the epidemic began.

uncertainty.note: Start is the date of the first CDC report; the pandemic continues. A later editorial note refers to it as the June 4 report. The WHO page does not state the year of its cumulative totals.
